preconditions.description: The number of data centers n, clients m, and day length h satisfy the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(u) == n and all(0 <= x < h for x in u)
preconditions.description: The maintenance hours list u contains exactly n integers, each between 0 and h-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(clients) == m and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in clients)
preconditions.description: The clients list contains exactly m pairs of distinct data center indices between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(u[a-1] != u[b-1] for a, b in clients)
preconditions.description: The initial maintenance schedule guarantees that for every client, the two data centers storing their data have different maintenance hours.

postconditions.expression: len(selected_indices) == k and 1 <= k <= n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in selected_indices) and len(set(selected_indices)) == k
postconditions.description: The output contains k distinct data center indices between 1 and n, matching the count k printed on the first line.

postconditions.expression: all((u[a-1] + (1 if a in selected_indices else 0)) % h != (u[b-1] + (1 if b in selected_indices else 0)) % h for a, b in clients)
postconditions.description: After shifting the maintenance hour by 1 (modulo h) for every data center in the selected set, the maintenance hours of the two data centers for every client remain distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(s)) >= len(selected_indices) for s in [set(selected_indices)]) and k == min(len(s) for s in [selected_indices] if all((u[a-1] + (1 if a in s else 0)) % h != (u[b-1] + (1 if b in s else 0)) % h for a, b in clients))
postconditions.description: The number of selected data centers k is the minimum possible size of any subset of data centers that satisfies the accessibility guarantee after shifting.
